scope: Source-asset and source-data provenance mapped onto the physical ROM ledger. This index does not classify bytes as executable or nonexecutable.

receipt_inventory.name: banim-data-classification
receipt_inventory.note: Addressed asset rows are checked against source files and ROM bytes. This is provenance evidence only.

receipt_inventory.name: banim-graphics-rebuild
receipt_inventory.note: Rebuild receipt joins to the addressed battle-animation assets; it adds no separate physical interval rows.

receipt_inventory.name: banim-source-rebuild
receipt_inventory.note: Source section hashes join to the addressed compressed or raw battle-animation asset records; no separate physical interval rows.

receipt_inventory.name: final-unmapped-provenance
receipt_inventory.note: Fresh-source or explicit-source residual records are hash-checked against ROM bytes; the compiler, ELF, map, and source pins are checked when present.

receipt_inventory.name: function-pointer-data-owners
receipt_inventory.note: Verified source-asset words are expanded to their complete source intervals and checked against ROM. Duplicate-asset rows require independent full-copy byte equality.

receipt_inventory.name: function-pointer-residuals
receipt_inventory.note: Pointer candidates and payload matches do not identify complete source-asset extents.

receipt_inventory.name: message-data-classification
receipt_inventory.note: Per-message addresses are reconstructed from current linked ELF symbols and generated source, then checked against each receipt stream hash, decoded-token hash, ROM bytes, object extent, and zero alignment.

receipt_inventory.name: orphan-duplicate
receipt_inventory.note: Copy relationships and mixed duplicate contents are not source-asset provenance.

receipt_inventory.name: orphan-runtime-copy
receipt_inventory.note: Reconstructed runtime-copy relationships are not source-asset provenance.

receipt_inventory.name: residual-table-provenance
receipt_inventory.note: Numeric tables have explicit addresses. Two binary graphics rows are located through their matching residual intervals in the unmapped-asset receipt.

receipt_inventory.name: sound-relocations
receipt_inventory.note: Relocation and pointer-word evidence supplements sample intervals; it is not a separate asset extent receipt.

receipt_inventory.name: sound-sample-data
receipt_inventory.note: Current indexed .bin source hashes, ROM bytes, direct-sound assembly source hash, and converter source hash are checked. The receipt has no AIFF input hashes, so unchanged AIFF inputs are not independently certified.

receipt_inventory.name: sound-sample-references
receipt_inventory.note: Instrument pointer records join to the source sample inventory; the receipt has no sample extents of its own.

receipt_inventory.name: unmapped-asset-provenance
receipt_inventory.note: Source-declared binary asset bindings are checked byte-for-byte; residual rows remain explicit and may be covered by later receipts.
